articles.title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
articles.description: Strategy, Coinbase, Circle and Robinhood are among six companies from the venture’s initial selection with no disclosed objection, after 90% of issuers opted out.

articles.title: U.S. prediction markets regulator issues demand that clashes directly with courts
articles.description: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said regulated exchanges can't cut off customers state-by-state, but firms like Kalshi are under court orders to do so.

articles.title: The crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story
articles.description: Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle are expanding into stablecoins, payments and prediction markets, but their latest earnings show how hard it is to escape crypto's boom-and-bust cycles.

articles.title: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty
articles.description: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, alleging it ran an unlicensed crypto exchange for Thai users from 2022 to 2025.

articles.title: U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October, blowing past 65,000 estimate
articles.description: The unemployment rate unexpectedly fell to 4.1%. The strong showing surely puts a December rate hike in play, but next week's inflation numbers and the fate of the stock market could prove more important.

articles.title: Over $1 billion in bullish bets liquidated while ETF flows suggest no help in spot market
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 6, 2026

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin flatlines under $76,000 as stock bounce loses steam into the close
articles.description: The Nasdaq gained just 1.1%, while the S&P 500 only edged higher, and the DJIA lost more ground.

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies after AI-led selloff as eyes turn to latest U.S. jobs figures
articles.description: Bitcoin bounced from around $75,200 after Thursday’s AI-led selloff, which drove more than $1 billion in liquidations, as traders await the U.S. jobs report.

articles.title: Bitcoin recovers $76,000 level as ETFs shed $430 million after tech rout
articles.description: Bitcoin recovered above $76,000 Friday after dropping below that level during Thursday's tech-driven market rout.

articles.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains and 15% levy on DeFi income
articles.description: Investors will have 12 months to declare past crypto gains without late-filing penalties, though questions remain over crypto-to-crypto swaps.

articles.title: Trump-backed World Liberty Financial plans token buyback after 66% year-to-date slide
articles.description: The crypto venture may use fees from its USD1 stablecoin reserves to fund token purchases as it seeks to boost governance.

articles.title: Zcash’s landmark NU7 upgrade goes live, speeding up private payments
articles.description: NU7 cuts the target time between blocks to 25 seconds, reduces the work wallets must do to find private payments and sets aside fees for future miners.

articles.title: Hyperliquid treasury firm seeking U.S. regulatory nod as a domestic futures platform
articles.description: The company said it's trying to establish a U.S. "futures commission merchant" with full compliance for activity with U.S. clients, though the timing is uncertain.

articles.title: Bitcoin developer proposes ‘landmines’ to make quantum thieves lose their own BTC
articles.description: Anyone trying to move vulnerable bitcoin would have to put up matching collateral, giving prepared owners a chance to take both.

articles.title: U.S. Justice Department assembles force to shield against foreign AI threats
articles.description: The new DOJ task force will aid the recently designated U.S. "SI Force" by warding off bad actors backed by other nations, criminal groups or corporate fraud.

articles.title: Bitcoin tumbles to $76,000 as collapsing AI trade drags stocks sharply lower
articles.description: The post-election rally quickly reversed as AI stocks plunged, but cryptocurrencies held up relatively better despite a $1 billion liquidation wave.

articles.title: What is TraderTraitor, the hacking squad behind the $6.3 billion Binance heist?
articles.description: The hacking group has been behind some of the crypto industry's most recent high-profile thefts.

articles.title: Standard Chartered and SBI back crypto insurer Soter as funding reaches $23.5 million
articles.description: Soter also received backing of 500 BTC and 2000 ETH, worth another $43 million at current prices.

articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: Where investors stake crypto shapes how much of the reward they keep
Gate CEO says crypto exchanges must prove they can survive a hack like Binance’s
articles.description: Lin Han says Gate holds enough assets in cold storage to cover customer balances even if its hot wallets are emptied. An independent audit is underway.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward and its clients buy AAVE tokens in DeFi investment push
articles.description: The investment follows talks first reported by CoinDesk in June that included a proposed equity stake in Aave Group.

articles.title: Google could take stake in bitcoin miner TeraWulf’s $19 billion AI project if Anthropic defaults
articles.description: A $19 billion data-center agreement includes an unusual provision allowing Google to acquire part of the project if Anthropic fails to pay its rent.

articles.title: Binance cuts SignalPlus access after security warning, urges users to check accounts
articles.description: The exchange says its systems are unaffected but has removed trading connections to the third-party platform as a precaution.

articles.title: Ukraine’s central bank opposes crypto bill, citing monetary sovereignty concerns
articles.description: Ukraine’s central bank won’t back a crypto legalization bill in its current form and wants lawmakers to revise it before a final vote.
